analysis.one_line_summary: Silent UGC-style demo of a creator styling voluminous layered hair using a pink thermal round brush to a trending song.
analysis.full_description: A young woman demonstrates how she styles her dark layered hair using a pink heated round brush. She rolls different sections, including sides, back, and bangs, showing the smooth, curled results. She concludes by fluffing her voluminous hair and presenting the tool to the camera.

scenes.visual: Creator rolling an upper side strand around the heated round brush.
scenes.action: Wraps hair around brush, holds, and releases to reveal a smooth wave.

scenes.visual: Creator curling the lower side sections with the thermal brush.
scenes.action: Twists and slides brush through hair ends, then shows the bouncy result.

scenes.visual: Creator styles front bangs, then turns to show back of styled hair.
scenes.action: Runs thermal brush through bangs, turns around to display volume and layers at the back.

scenes.visual: Creator working on the root volume and top layers.
scenes.action: Lifts roots and curls front hair sections backward.
Rakes fingers through bouncy curls, poses, and holds the pink thermal brush toward camera.
